description: Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in establishing a modern Public Service delivery mechanism between Azerbaijan and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the State Agency for Public Service and Social Innovations of Azerbaijan and the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government of Sri Lanka, on cooperation in the field of innovating public service delivery, in conjunction with the United Nations Governance Innovation Summit, scheduled to be held in Azerbaijan on 5th and 6th November 2026. The said MoU aims to achieve objectives such as conducting training programmes, internships in the relevant fields and facilitation for the same, establishing of a monitoring mechanism to ensure qualitative and effective service delivery, and carrying out service assessments. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to sign the proposed MoU to be effective for a period of 03 years, between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.
